name: Yas Marina Circuit (2009-2020)
description: Yas Marina in Abu Dhabi, past the marina and under the hotel bridge. Long straights, slow corners, and a race that starts in daylight and ends under the lights.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (1439 of 2220 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
